_note: The Arcane Crafting Terminal. An ME terminal to see the network with, a crafting table to lay ingredients on, thaumium for the housing and a salis mundus to bind the halves together. 100 vis - the most capable thing this addon builds, and the 1.12.2 tree prices it above the assembly chamber.
_crystals: aer, declared rather than placed: a crystal in the pattern shows in JEI as an unknown crystal, because the aspect is a component. See focus_aewrench.json. Only a PRIMAL aspect is accepted here - fabrico was tried first and the recipe failed to load with ''thaumaturge:fabrico is not a primal aspect''. The six are aer, ignis, aqua, terra, ordo and perditio.
